topic: how to delete zelle recipient on chase app
slug: how to delete zelle recipient on chase app

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap "Pay & transfer" on the bottom navigation bar.
Tap the gear icon in the top right, then tap "Manage recipients".
Find the recipient you want to remove and tap their name.
Tap "Delete" on the confirmation pop-up to confirm.
The confirmation screen shows the recipient has been removed from your Zelle recipients.
